title: Use Tiles, redone: a prompt per tile, a tile size, and Use Grid removed (2.1.3+)
description: Target 2.1.3 or later, not 2.1.2. REPLACES Use Tiles (MPI-1038) and REMOVES Use Grid (Fabio 2026-10-21). Use Tiles on shows Tile size (-> ImpactMakeTileSEGS bbox_size) and a Describe each tile toggle (per-tile captions via the DetailerForEach wildcard). Cloud masks already hide seams; faces excluded from the grid, redrawn whole. Bench before wiring. Brief: brief.md.
